name: Hamad International Airport

runway.v: two parallel runways; the longer, 16L/34R, is 4,850 m long and 60 m wide (16R/34L is 4,250 m x 60 m); the eastern runway is currently open at reduced length during remediation works

permits.v: non-scheduled flights need prior landing permission from the Qatar Civil Aviation Authority, requested through its online portal at least 72 hours before the flight
permits.quote: it is necessary for the operator to obtain prior landing/overflying permission from the QCAA ... at least seventy-two (72) hours

slots.v: non-scheduled flights must also apply for schedule/slot approval (IATA Chapter 6 format) to the Qatar slot coordination office
slots.quote: All Non-Scheduled flights should apply for schedule/slot approval as per IATA Chapter 6 format.
